name: Google Cloud
description: Cloud Run, Cloud Functions, GKE, Compute Engine, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub and load balancer metrics from Cloud Monitoring.

queries.name: 5xx Responses by Service
queries.whereClause: attr.response_code_class = "5xx" AND resource.cloud.account.id = "$project" AND resource.cloud.region = "$region" AND service.name = "$workload"

queries.name: Request Latency p95 by Service
queries.whereClause: attr.quantile = "0.95" AND resource.cloud.account.id = "$project" AND resource.cloud.region = "$region" AND service.name = "$workload"

queries.name: Active Instances by Service
queries.whereClause: attr.state = "active" AND resource.cloud.account.id = "$project" AND resource.cloud.region = "$region" AND service.name = "$workload"
